subject: dec-document-defaults
text: - **[Document defaults]** Incremental layout defaults to `true` (packages/blitz-dom/src/config.rs:56; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:521); CSS media type defaults to `screen` (packages/blitz-dom/src/config.rs:50-52; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:477); documents are always HTML in no-quirks mode (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:479; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1740; packages/blitz-dom/src/net.rs:171; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:260-266; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo_device.rs:74; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/document.rs:129-133; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/element/geometry.rs:78-79); Stylo prefs enabled: grid, flexbox balance, unimplemented layout, columns, basic-shape `shape()`, tree-counting functions, `progress()`, variable fonts and, under the `writing-mode` feature, `layout.writing-mode.enabled`, with `layout.threads` -1 (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:90-100); the default `DocumentUrl` is an empty base64 `data:text/css` URL (packages/blitz-dom/src/url.rs:34-37); headless documents and the WPT viewport use `ColorScheme::Light` (examples/screenshot.rs:76-81; examples/paint_bench.rs:94-99; wpt/runner/src/main.rs:552-557)

subject: dec-resource-loading
text: - **[Resource loading]** `<head>` stylesheets are render-blocking critical resources and `resolve` returns before styling while any are pending (packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1408-1412; packages/blitz-dom/src/resolve.rs:52-63; tests/blitz-tests/tests/render_blocking_stylesheet.rs:3-8; tests/blitz-tests/tests/render_blocking_stylesheet.rs:122-124); a `<link>` starts loading once it has both `rel=stylesheet` and an `href` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/link_rel_attribute.rs:1-7); iframe nesting capped by `MAX_SUBDOCUMENT_DEPTH = 10` (packages/blitz-dom/src/iframe.rs:15-18; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1490-1497); nested `@import` capped by `MAX_IMPORT_DEPTH = 16` (packages/blitz-dom/src/net.rs:182-186; packages/blitz-dom/src/net.rs:209-217); an iframe's `srcdoc` takes precedence over `src` (packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1504-1509); loaded images are cached by URL with concurrent requests queued on one fetch (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:407-414; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1447-1472); author stylesheets are ordered by owner node id, with a TODO that node reuse could make that order wrong (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1777-1793; packages/blitz-dom/src/cssom.rs:288-290)

subject: dec-css-approximations
text: - **[CSS approximations]** CSSOM geometry snapped to 1/64px, Blink's `LayoutUnit` precision (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:3524-3529); alignment `flex-start`/`flex-end` patched to `flow-start`/`flow-end` because Stylo does not yet do it (packages/blitz-dom/src/resolved_style.rs:774-797); `line-height: normal` approximated as 1.2 × font size for percentage baseline shifts (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo_to_parley.rs:382-386); `baseline-shift: center` approximated with middle alignment (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo_to_parley.rs:373-377); `overflow: auto` maps to taffy `Overflow::Scroll` (packages/stylo_taffy/src/convert.rs:412-413); `display: table` maps to taffy Grid (packages/stylo_taffy/src/convert.rs:237-240); `scrollbar_width` always 0.0 (packages/stylo_taffy/src/wrapper.rs:220-223; packages/stylo_taffy/src/convert.rs:979); `gap: normal` resolves to 0 (packages/stylo_taffy/src/convert.rs:652-654); sizing keywords on min/max size resolve to auto (packages/stylo_taffy/src/convert.rs:134-140; packages/stylo_taffy/src/convert.rs:154-160); baseline content-alignment falls back to start/end and last-baseline maps to end (packages/stylo_taffy/src/convert.rs:479-482; packages/stylo_taffy/src/convert.rs:594-596); block-container positional content-alignment defaults to `safe`, a table cell counting as a block container (packages/stylo_taffy/src/convert.rs:454-496; packages/stylo_taffy/src/convert.rs:486-497); `align-items`/`justify-items`/`align-self`/`justify-self: normal` map to Taffy's `NORMAL` keyword, which Taffy resolves by the aligned box's layout mode — a container's `auto` or unknown flag too (packages/stylo_taffy/src/convert.rs:568-580; packages/stylo_taffy/src/convert.rs:642-647); insets reported auto for `position: static` (packages/stylo_taffy/src/convert.rs:279-292)

subject: dec-unsupported-features
text: - **[Unsupported features]** Shadow DOM not implemented (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:278-287; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:359-362; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:634-643); container queries disabled by a default size (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:1236-1242); 3D transforms dropped, z-axis rotate applied as planar (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo_to_kurbo.rs:40-46; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo_to_kurbo.rs:64-73; tests/blitz-tests/tests/rotate_z_axis.rs:1-8; tests/blitz-tests/tests/rotate_z_axis.rs:59-63); CSS `offset` not supported in transforms (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo_to_kurbo.rs:81-82); visited-link styling disabled (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:133; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:213); `:focus-visible`, `:valid`, `:invalid`, `:required`, `:target` always match false (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:463-511), while `:focus-within` matches the focused element and its ancestors by the `FOCUS_WITHIN` element state (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:480-482; [DOM semantics]); anchor positioning "flagged off for time being" with size variants hitting `unreachable!()` (packages/stylo_taffy/src/convert.rs:122-124; packages/stylo_taffy/src/convert.rs:142-144; packages/stylo_taffy/src/convert.rs:197-200); grid subgrid and masonry convert to none / empty (packages/stylo_taffy/src/wrapper.rs:791-793; packages/stylo_taffy/src/convert.rs:811-813); `text-indent`'s `hanging` and `each-line` flags are read from the style and handed to Parley (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/inline/layout.rs:486-489), and that they do not work, their parsing cfg'd out in Stylo, is recorded, not established: the upstream comment that stated it left the file at the 2026-10-10 sync, stylo unmoved at 0.22.0, and no reading of either flag was taken; pseudo-element `content` supports only strings (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/construct.rs:663-680); anonymous table wrapper boxes are not generated (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/construct.rs:585-604)

dec-scrolling-and-input
text: - Seven direct engine changes for every document stand beside those eight, each ratified by the founder (2026-10-18): `inert` honoured and `disabled` read on a form control alone ([DOM semantics]); the builder's toggle read per role, the hit's stop at a `contain: paint` box and `Node::absolute_position` less its containing blocks' scroll alone (above); a click in a password `input` placing the caret by its bullets — `ClickTarget::TextInput` carries a `password` flag (an `input` whose `type` reads `password`, ASCII case-insensitive), and the private `click_password_input` lays out one U+2022 per character through `BaseDocument::layout_as_text_input`, scrolls that layout as paint scrolls it, finds the bullet under the point with parley's `Cursor::from_point` and moves the real editor to that character's byte offset — a click `move_to_byte`, a shift-click `extend_selection_to_byte`, two or more clicks `select_all` — every other text input keeping `move_to_point` on the editor's own layout (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:657-723); and the client rect read where an element's transforms move it (§Standard Contracts → Scrolling, selection, tree). `aria-activedescendant` stays unread and a box with no area stays hit at its centre, stated in `covered`'s meaning (§Standard Contracts → Driver session) — neither an engine change. Each of the seven is flagged upstreamable against upstream `main` at `23b9b26a9` with no upstream pull request open; their merge surface, by file (escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-18-engine-debts/evidence/merge-surface.md), is owned by a `.andromeda/residuals.md` line, re-read row by row with its owner quoted (as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-27-upstream-sync-engine-debts/evidence/readings.md), its owner Epoch 3's «Upstream sync ahead of the UI graph» (inputs#I5).

text: - The document's clock stands beside the seven, ratified by the founder (2026-10-18): every engine time read — the overlay scrollbar fade, the double-click window, pan and the fling's generation, the smooth-scroll start, the fling and smooth frames — goes through `DocumentConfig.clock`, wall time when it is unset and a harness's `VirtualClock` headlessly, with `FADE_DELAY`, `FADE_DURATION`, the 500 ms and 2 px, the 300 ms smooth duration and the fling constants unchanged (§Standard Contracts → Document core); an API addition whose default keeps every windowed and embedder-built document's behaviour, flagged upstreamable against upstream `main` with no upstream pull request open, its merge surface — `packages/blitz-dom/src/{config,clock,document,resolve,iframe,scrolling}.rs` and `packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs` — owned by the same `.andromeda/residuals.md` line, whose owner is Epoch 3's «Upstream sync ahead of the UI graph» (inputs#I5).

subject: dec-scrolling-and-input
text:
- The select model stands beside them, a direct engine change for every document, remote pages included: a focused single-choice `select` (no `multiple`), its list closed, that is no disabled form control takes a pressed `ArrowDown` / `ArrowUp` to the next / previous enabled option and `Home` / `End` to the first / last (with none chosen, `ArrowDown` reads as `Home` and `ArrowUp` as `End`), and a character pressed with no Ctrl, Alt or Meta as typeahead — the first enabled option whose label starts with the buffered text, compared in lower case, the buffer (`select_typeahead`) starting afresh for another select or once the document's clock has moved 1 s (`TYPEAHEAD_TIMEOUT`); Enter, and a Space with no typed text standing, opens its list (below), every other key does nothing, and a released Space does nothing more (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:112-117; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:171-255; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:375-396). A click on a select clears the typeahead and the document's text selection and focuses it through `generate_focus_events` / `set_focus_to`, and on a single select opens its list or closes one standing; the walk's disabled gate stops a disabled select first, so it neither focuses nor acts (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:947-960). Every choice that changes the chosen option or a `multiple` select's chosen set goes through the one path `apply_select_choice`, which takes the chosen set — the `CHECKED` write, the changed set, `input` then `change`, each carrying `select_value`, and a redraw — and a choice of the chosen option fires nothing (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:470-496). Its limits: a single select's `size` is unread, and an option of a closed single select is not clicked (a driver `click` on one is refused `covered`, under a group too). Its choice model is [DOM semantics]'.
 Flagged upstreamable, with no upstream pull request open; its merge surface, by file — blitz-dom `node/select.rs`, `document.rs`, `events/{keyboard,pointer,mod}.rs`, `mutator.rs`, `accessibility.rs`, `form.rs`, `node/element.rs` and `assets/default.css`, blitz-traits `events.rs` and blitz-vibey-script `runtime/events.rs` — is owned by the same `.andromeda/residuals.md` line, whose owner is Epoch 3's «Upstream sync ahead of the UI graph» (inputs#I5).

Each stands ratified for its take under the playbook pattern for an engine behaviour change for every document; the `file:` refusal is a narrowing and the accessors a realization on the registered script-to-DOM crossing (as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-27-upstream-sync-engine-debts/report.md).

subject: dec-scrolling-and-input
text: - A measured hazard of the overlay scrollbar, no engine change: right after a `scroll`, a main-button pointerdown at a point in the shown overlay scrollbar's band is taken as a thumb drag and dispatches nothing (`events/pointer.rs`, `hit_with_scrollbar` while `scrollbar_opacity > 0`); on the virtual clock the bar stays shown until an `advance` passes its fade, and a pointer left on the thumb keeps it shown — so a driver `click` inside a just-scrolled box needs an `advance` past the fade first, as `stand_cells_served` walks Cells to `Z25` with `advance 5000` (as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-25-cold-agent-bar/report.md). A row of an open select list is never taken as a thumb drag, `hit_with_scrollbar` answering `select_list_hit` first and no scrollbar with it (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:2436-2438); the hazard stands at every other overlay scrollbar.

subject: dec-layout
text:
- **[Layout]** HTML tables are laid out by Taffy's grid through `TableTreeWrapper` (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/mod.rs:534-538; packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/table.rs:770-789) with `GridAutoFlow::RowDense` (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/table.rs:223-228); fixed table layout only with `table-layout: fixed` and non-auto width, percentage columns only then (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/table.rs:232-236; packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/table.rs:248-255); table-internal margins zeroed and `rowspan` clamped to 1..=65534 (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/table.rs:706-707; packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/table.rs:630-634); table scrollable overflow capped at node size, marked `HACK` (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/mod.rs:569-577); replaced elements are `img`, `svg`, `canvas`, `video`, `embed`, `iframe`, `<object>` excluded so fallback children render (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/replaced.rs:7-17); atomic inline boxes add `input`, `textarea`, `button` (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/replaced.rs:441-448); default object size 300x150, an unloaded image zero (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/mod.rs:41-46; packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/mod.rs:58-60; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/svg.rs:217-224; tests/blitz-tests/tests/custom_widget_layout.rs:69-78; tests/blitz-tests/tests/custom_widget_layout.rs:102-111); text nodes are never laid out individually (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/mod.rs:244-257); text inputs get a Parley editor, checkbox/radio get checkbox data (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/construct.rs:427-444) and, since 2026-10-13-range-input-interaction, a range input gets `RangeInputData`, seeded from its sanitized `value` attribute only when it holds none — so a re-construction keeps a moved value — and cleared to `None` when the element no longer reads `type="range"`, construction then continuing as before with no early return (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/construct.rs:422;
 packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/construct.rs:944-962; [Scrolling and input]), the editor constructed with size 16.0 (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/text.rs:85-92); floats compile only with `floats` (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/inline/layout.rs:16-19; packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/inline/layout.rs:405-408); damage bits `ONLY_RELAYOUT`, `REORDER_CHILDREN`, `CONSTRUCT_BOX`, `CONSTRUCT_FC`, `CONSTRUCT_DESCENDENT`, `ALL_DAMAGE` over Servo's `RestyleDamage`, `REORDER_CHILDREN` not part of `ALL_DAMAGE` (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/damage.rs:23-44); display/float/position/contain/visibility/font/text-shaping changes yield `ALL_DAMAGE`, an in-flow `order` change `RELAYOUT | REORDER_CHILDREN`, else `RELAYOUT` (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/damage.rs:361-486); flex/grid children stable-sorted by `order`, skipped when all are 0 (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/damage.rs:488-499; packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/construct.rs:560-561), kept persistently sorted (tests/blitz-tests/tests/flex_grid_order.rs:1-4), abspos children keying as `order` 0 (tests/blitz-tests/tests/flex_grid_order.rs:149-155); z-index-auto positioned boxes share one paint level and only non-zero z-index stacking contexts are hoisted (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/paint_tree.rs:420-461; packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/paint_tree.rs:338-346); out-of-flow boxes are painted and hit-tested by their containing block (tests/blitz-tests/tests/paint_tree_incremental.rs:489-491), hoisted offsets computed at most once per geometry generation (tests/blitz-tests/tests/paint_tree_incremental.rs:275-316)
